text: type tile_heatmap, effect_points numeric_points. mapping Named character vector data column names. Heatmaps require x, y, value; effects numeric points require x, y, colour. row_key Nonempty character vector complete unique-key columns. levels Named list explicit unique character levels: x/y heatmaps, y/colour effects, colour numeric points, plus facet_rows/facet_columns requested facets. Numeric-point facets use fixed scales space directions. Facets aggregate values. labels Named list optional title/x/y/fill/colour/caption text; numeric points also accept subtitle. Explicit NULL removes label; empty text remains distinct label. midpoint Required finite scalar available heatmaps; empty heatmaps may supply NULL. Must NULL effects numeric points. reference Finite vertical reference effects; NULL heatmaps. Numeric points accept NULL finite horizontal reference within y limits. style Named list presentation overrides: base_size, family, low, mid, high, point_size, tile_linewidth, x_angle, strip_y_angle (default -90). Optional positive finite text_size overrides root text, preserving geom defaults explicit child text sizes. Omission preserves legacy recipes. expressions allowed. status Explicit available empty heatmaps/effects, agreeing supplied rows. Numeric points require available nonempty data. provenance Named character vector caller declarations, verified evidence. excluded scientific payload hash. display_labels Optional complete named plaintext maps categorical x/y axes facet_rows/facet_columns. Numeric points permit facet maps; numeric axis labels come numeric_axes. Map keys original levels. Newlines repeated display text allowed without merging categories. Omitted roles use identity labels; colour labels mapped . numeric_axes Numeric points : named x/y lists, containing limits (two strictly increasing finite values), breaks (unique increasing finite values within limits), equally long character labels vector. axes required. Coordinates outside declared limits refused. colour_values Numeric points : complete named colour vector whose unique names exactly match levels$colour. Colour order follows levels. annotation Numeric points : NULL named list column, nudge_x, nudge_y, size_pt, check_overlap show_legend. Nudges must finite; size_pt must finite least 7; policies must logical scalars. Text size uses ggplot2's 72.27 points per inch conversion. Annotation records retained; clipping overlap suppression can hide text. Actual visible label coverage exported glyph sizes require device visual checks.

title: reflowR 0.1.0
text: Initial release. reflow_init() – main function wrapping workflowr::wflow_start() theming. Five color schemes: clinical (red), basic (steelblue), code (forest green), special (purple), (grey). Three depth presets: minimal (3 steps), standard (8 steps), extended (12 steps). Custom SVG icons per scheme embedded navbar. CSS/SCSS theme generation color scheme definitions. reflow_preview() interactive color preview. reflow_schemes() reflow_presets() convenience functions. Full compatibility workflowr commands (wflow_build, wflow_publish, etc.). Two vignettes: Getting Started Color Schemes Reference.
